City is not too sad to let her go.
Fortunately, there will be more female doctors appearing in the drama series this autumn.
Holby: City, which has a breakaway sister show, is also being restructured and will feature female leads alongside males.
Dean Norris, from Breaking Bad, will portray the doc's brother Chris, while the role of Jimmy Firo’s niece is taken on by Swedish actress Frida Farrell.
Newcomers to the cast include Kim Logan as Sonya Grayson, Adele Oni as Dr Oludara Olaosebikan, and Hong Kong-born Lois Delfor playing game show character Nina Arden.
